summary: ## **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** ## **Petition No. 50/TD/2026** ## **Coram:** **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member** **Date of Order: 9[th] February, 2026** ## **In the matter of** Application for grant of licence under Section 14 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for grant of trading license and other related matters) Regulations, 2020. ## **And** ## **In the matter of** ## **Top Notch Energy Solutions,** Shop no.-1A, Ground floor, Shopping Complex, PARSVNATH REGALIA, Raj Bagh, Sahibabad, Ghaziabad - 201005 **Petitioner** ## **Parties Present:** None ## **ORDER** The Petitioner, Top Notch Energy Solutions, has filed the present Petition for the grant of inter-State trading licence under Section 14 of the Electricity Act, 2003 (‘the Act’) read with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for grant of trading license and other related matters) Regulations, 2020 (in short “Trading Licence Regulations’). 2. The case was called out for hearing on 5.2.2026. However, none appeared on behalf of the Petitioner either in person or through counsel. There was also no prior Order in Petition No. 50/TD/2026 Page 1 intimation from the Petitioner indicating the reasons for such absence or seeking an adjournment. It appears that the Petitioner is not interested in prosecuting the Petition. 3. _Prima facie,_ even the Petition does not appear to be complete in all aspects as required under the Trading Licence Regulations. Accordingly, the Petition is dismissed for default on the part of the Petitioner under Regulation 42(1) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023. 4. Petition No. 50/TD/2026 is disposed of in terms of the above. Sd/sd/sd/- **(Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Chairperson** Order in Petition No. 50/TD/2026 Page 2 CERC Website S. No. 99/2026
